strategy.offer: Independent quality assurance software, instruments, calibration, and support services for radiation therapy, proton therapy, and medical imaging.
strategy.customers: Medical physicists and healthcare providers that need dependable quality control, commissioning, verification, and ongoing equipment support in radiation-based care.
strategy.why_we_win: It combines independent, precise, integrated QA with flexible workflows, automation, predictive analysis, and always-available expert service to improve efficiency and patient safety.
strategy.resources: Decades of scientific dosimetry experience, clinically trained physicists and engineers, a global support organization, software integration capabilities, and accredited calibration laboratory services.
strategy.direction: Advance independent QA through convergence of machine and patient QA, driven by measurement, integration, automation, and prediction.
